finding_measured.defect: The matrix classified requirement rows by grammatical mood rather than by semantic predicate. A row stating an obligation with a deontic modal was REQUIRED; a row stating the same class of obligation in declarative form was REFERENCE_ONLY.
finding_measured.authority_violated: STRATEGY_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACEABILITY_STANDARD.md section 2 permits reference classification only for headings, list introducers, labels, descriptive context, examples, introductory prose, and context-dependent bare fragments. Mood is not among them, and section 1 states the unit of proof is a semantic predicate.
finding_measured.measurement_method: Enumerated runs were detected as contiguous same-marker list rows inside one strategy document and section; a run holding both REQUIRED and REFERENCE_ONLY members is inconsistent by the matrix's own hand rather than by outside judgement.
worked_examples: Domain_Boundary_Invariants_LOCKED.md 'Boundary invariants': 14 numbered items, of which 2, 11, 12, 14 were REQUIRED and 1, 3-10, 13 were REFERENCE_ONLY. The four kept items are the four containing a modal.
Terminology_and_Scope.md 'Locked interpretation rules': 19 items, of which only item 2 was REFERENCE_ONLY. It is the one item without 'must never'.

Terminology_and_Scope.md 'decision-grade (LOCKED)': 4 conditions, of which only condition 3 was REQUIRED, though MD-S056-R0004 states the term must not stay undefined and the platform target rests on all four.

MARKET_DATA_PLATFORM_EOD_BASELINE.md 'Anti-assumption rules': 19 forbidden claims, of which R0127-R0141 were REQUIRED and R0142-R0145 were not; the cut is where the list was truncated, not what the entries mean.
finding_measured.relationship_to_prior_remediation: F-MD-B01-A001-001 states the defect runs both ways and cites five homogeneous-list splits as evidence. MD-B01-A004 remediated the demotion direction and measured non-predicate required rows to 0. Three of the five cited splits were still present unchanged at this baseline: MD-S001-R0099 (1 of 10 ownership bullets required), MD-S056-R0053 (1 of 8 target-output bullets required), and MD-S001-R0074 (1 of 4 provider-limitation bullets required). A004 promoted 817 children of introducers it demoted; these three introducers were already REFERENCE_ONLY, so their children were never in the promotion set.

rules_advanced.normalized_predicate: The eligible compatibility-alias lifecycle requires that `data_usable` is the canonical field and `eligible` is a compatibility alias retained solely so existing consumers do not break.

The eligible compatibility-alias lifecycle requires that until retirement, no new artifact, column, reason code, config key, or API field may be named with `eligible`; new surfaces use `data_usable`, and the alias may be preserved, not propagated.
rules_advanced.surfaces_covered: columns, enum vocabulary, reason codes, and command signatures by the existing A002 guard; configuration keys and API fields by the new A014 guard; the positive half by the read product exposing data_usable and an explicit DATA_USABLE/DATA_NOT_USABLE state beside the alias

tooling_result.why_the_existing_gates_could_not_see_it: MarketDataTraceabilityApplicabilityGate validates rows that are already REQUIRED, so a row wrongly excluded is invisible to it. MarketDataScopeBoundaryCompletionGate asserted the denominator had not drifted from 143 without checking how 143 was derived. Both returned PASS against a figure this attempt proves wrong; a gate that locks a number without checking its derivation reports PASS for exactly as long as the derivation stays broken.
tooling_result.vacuity_floors: The new gate fails when it reads fewer than 6000 active rows or detects fewer than 200 enumerated runs, so a scan that silently matches nothing cannot be mistaken for a clean corpus.

negative_and_fail_closed_proof.method: Every mutation is asserted to have landed before the guard is judged. One mutation in this attempt reported 'guard did not react' while the replacement string had not matched at all; it was re-run with a landing assertion and the guard then failed correctly. That is the second instance of the shape recorded at MD-B01-A002.
